mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the dimension upon which some various conceptions and differences exist among Christian churches and traditions."
The extent of atonement is the dimension upon which some various conceptions and differences exist among Christian churches and traditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to understand and justify God's love and holiness in the midst of human suffering."
Theodicy is an attempt to understand and justify God's love and holiness in the midst of human suffering.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study of doctrine of the Church."
Ecclesiology is the study of doctrine of the Church.

Justification is a forensic term and has to do with the law-courts, for it is the decision or verdict of the judge.

The attributes are the reason Christian Theism affirms the existence of the God of the Bible.

Doctrine is the word that is used to describe a body of acceptable teachings of the Bible.

Obedience is the key word here: it was the lack of it that brought condemnation and the presence of it justification.

Elohim means the 'Most-high God' or 'the exalted One'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to construct the God-head."
Trinity is an attempt to construct the God-head.

The soul is the psychological element in humans that enables human beings to reason, to have emotions and also to interact both with animals and other human beings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Christian reformed name for a Presbytery."
The Classis is the Christian reformed name for a Presbytery.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an Assembly of God's own people."
The Church is an Assembly of God's own people.
